candidates.summary: Indian authorities released Cockroach Janata Party leaders Abhijeet Dipke, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, one day after detaining them before a New Delhi demonstration over voter-list revisions. The movement’s legal director said their release was conditioned on committing no breach of peace for one year; it was unclear how that condition would affect future protest activity. Police also detained protesters during demonstrations Sunday.
candidates.title: India releases leaders of youth protest movement

candidates.summary: Yemen’s Houthis renewed threats against Saudi aviation after the deadly attack on Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport. A Houthi military spokesman said Saudi airports were targets and urged people to heed the group’s warnings. The Saudi-led coalition has blamed the Houthis for the airport attack, while the group had not claimed responsibility for that strike.
candidates.title: Houthis renew threats against Saudi airports
